record.question: Who has become the 3rd Indian Cricketer to reach the coveted milestone of playing 500 international matches?
record.explanation: Answer A: MS Dhoni. MS Dhoni reached 500 international appearances in July 2018, becoming the third Indian to reach the mark after Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid. Reference: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/india-in-england/ms-dhoni-becomes-third-indian-to-play-500-international-matches/articleshow/64889549.cms.
